_readme: [DemonInvasionMadPet 2026-10-15] Hewing Laurel (Global Mid-Autumn 2023). Re-read on change. OFFICIAL = client (luaUiRes[1425]/[1410]/[1273][10295], dlgfelllaurel*, dlg23midautumntravel*, MidAutumn_Config[10295], Dialog_Info 1410-preview-config). DERIVED = chosen here (server-side values not in the client).
_points: OFFICIAL luaUiRes[1425].rule: 15 Cultivation per hew, 45 with the Divine Axe.
_pools: OFFICIAL items: DlgFellLaurelPreReward tReward1 'Normal Hewing Rewards' / tReward2 'Divine Axe Hewing Rewards'. Weights and the falling-light tier (1-6, client effect 2023zhongqiu11..16) DERIVED.
_attempts: DERIVED: Divine Axe attempts per Giant Pill (the window shows 'x%d to boost hewing state %d time(s)').
_dailyPills: DERIVED amount of the official 'Daily Sign-in Pack' Lunar Spirit Pill source (luaUiRes[1425].itemget1[1]); given once a day when the window opens.
_phaseRewards: DERIVED: the 44 Cultivation phases (tForce, OFFICIAL) pay a reward the server chooses; null = built in code from items of the two official hewing pools, growing every phase group (Prospect / Foundation / Golden Core / Nascent Soul / Soul Fusion / Great Ascension). Put a list of 44 item lists here to override.
_stages: OFFICIAL thresholds luaUiRes[1273][10295].Total and items MidAutumn_Config[10295].Rank.Total (stageRewards below).
_travel: OFFICIAL: 2 strength per travel (luaUiRes[1410].Rule), Mooncakes 3345018 restore strength, travel gives Cultivation (scoretip). DERIVED: 20 free strength a day, max 200, 2 strength per Mooncake, 10 Cultivation per travel.
_travelPool: OFFICIAL items Dialog_Info['1410-preview-config'][10295] (Travel Rewards preview); weights DERIVED.
